title: Trinity Artifact Manifest
description: Per-step manifest of artifacts produced by a single executor invocation. Cf. .ai/cli/core/executor.py ArtifactManifest dataclass. Consumed by Verifier (Phase 8 existence checks) and Audit (Phase 10 artifact-reference validation via scan_artifact_refs).

manifest_version.description: Version pin; bumped via Article XXIX when shape changes.

step_id.description: Step within the plan whose execution produced these artifacts.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact's bytes (canonical: sha256sum).

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of manifest write.

lease_id.description: Optional back-reference to the ExecutionLease whose authority produced these artifacts.
